data.prometheus.yml:
global:
  scrape_interval: 10s
scrape_configs:
- job_name: flashkart
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
  - role: pod
    namespaces:
      names: [flashkart]
  relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_scrape]
    regex: "true"
    action: keep
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_ip, __meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_port]
    regex: '(.+);(\d+)'
    replacement: '$1:$2'
    target_label: __address__
  - source_labels: [__address__, __meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_port]
    regex: '(.+);'
    replacement: '$1'
    target_label: __address__
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_container_port_name, __meta_kubernetes_pod_annotation_prometheus_io_port, __meta_kubernetes_pod_container_name]
    regex: 'http;;.*|.*;9249;flink-main-container'
    action: keep
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
    target_label: app
data.loki.yml:
auth_enabled: false
server:
  http_listen_port: 3100
common:
  instance_addr: 127.0.0.1
  path_prefix: /tmp/loki
  replication_factor: 1
  ring:
    kvstore:
      store: inmemory
  storage:
    filesystem:
      chunks_directory: /tmp/loki/chunks
      rules_directory: /tmp/loki/rules
schema_config:
  configs:
  - from: 2024-01-01
    store: tsdb
    object_store: filesystem
    schema: v13
    index:
      prefix: index_
      period: 24h
data.fluent-bit.conf:
[SERVICE]
    Flush 1
    Parsers_File /fluent-bit/etc/parsers.conf
[INPUT]
    Name tail
    Path /var/log/containers/*_flashkart_*.log
    Tag kube.*
    multiline.parser docker, cri
    DB /positions/tail.db
    Skip_Long_Lines On
[OUTPUT]
    Name loki
    Match kube.*
    Host loki
    Port 3100
    Labels job=flashkart
data.datasources.yaml:
apiVersion: 1
datasources:
- name: Prometheus
  uid: prometheus
  type: prometheus
  url: http://prometheus:9090
  isDefault: true
- name: Loki
  uid: loki
  type: loki
  url: http://loki:3100
